coverage.reason: Review-only HUD draft reuses current images and the real clan heraldry renderer inside the existing synthetic benchmark. Browser validation covers desktop and both landscape sizes, readable labels, image bounds, touch/hit targets, current comparison, saved shield changes, no-clan state, notification badges and isolated non-writing actions. Shared live sources, server authority and production entries are unchanged; no emulator suite is needed. The production build gate verifies preview-only files do not enter the published game.
